ac:rich-text-body.p: This page is part of the company Database Security Configuration Policy (SEC-POL-DB-001). Its requirements are mandatory for every database in scope. Deviations need an approved entry in the DB Security – Exceptions Register. CIS Benchmarks and Tenable audit files are the technical basis and assessment method; where this policy differs from CIS, this policy applies.

ul.li: Every exception needs a business justification, a compensating control, a named risk owner and an expiry date (max. 12 months).
CRITICAL controls: approval by the policy owner (CISO). Others: Head of Database Engineering and the application owner.
Ask Vulnerability Management to exclude the instance from that Tenable audit item, and record it in Excluded in Tenable?.
Put the Exception ID in the Comments column of the control on its platform page.

td.p: Approved and within its expiry date
Expires within 30 days; renew or remediate
Past expiry; the instance is non-compliant
